column1: # Hand decisions for variants that several rule files rewrite differently (decided 2026-11-15 on the
# mix7 rules; the block at the end was added 2026-11-17 for the 70/30 blend rules).
# variant<TAB>context<TAB>replacement, first matching line of a variant wins.
# context: * = anywhere; after:WORDS = only right after these words (the words are kept, with
#   after:de the "de " is consumed when the replacement starts with d'); before:WORDS = only right
#   before these words (the mirror of after:, the words are kept); before_vowel = only when
#   the next word starts with a vowel or h (the space after the variant is consumed).
# An empty replacement means: no rule at all for this variant in that context (too ambiguous).
# Every variant listed here is removed from the learned rule files; the surviving lines become
# 2026-11-17, conflicts new in the 70/30 blend rules
# étuximab (amended 2026-11-17): cetuximab after "plus" or a word ending in -s/-sse/-sses/-x (not -ux),
# rituximab after a word ending in -r, else nothing. The contexts cannot test a suffix, so the
# previous words are listed: those seen before a *ximab word in the blend70 transcripts, plus common ones.
# antibial: en tibiale before postérieure/antérieure, else en tibial.
# glissonne: gleason after "score de" or before a number (2 to 10), glisson after "capsule de",
# else nothing. glissone (one n) was added by Claude on 2026-11-17 as the same decision applied to
# the one-n spelling, confirmed by the owner the same day.
# glison (one s, one n) was added on 2026-11-17 by the owner's decision "only next to score"
# (gleason after "score de" or before 2 to 10, glisson after "capsule de", else nothing), written with Claude Code.
# All three: gleason also right after the article "le" ("le glison est de 7", "Le glissonne à 8"),
# owner's decision of 2026-11-17 (near capsule -> glisson, near score or a number -> gleason), written with Claude Code.
# Both are a person's name, so every replacement below is capitalised (Gleason, capsule de Glisson), and
# all three also get Gleason right after "un" ("un glison à 7"): owner's decision of 2026-11-17, written with Claude Code.
